The Congo 

Students studied the history of the Congo Free State and King Leopold's atrocities as well as
post-Leopold history through Lumumba and to the present day with the current rule of 
Mobutu.

They read not only history but also Conrad's 
Heart of Darkness,
 and heard a lecture by Tikumbi
Lumumba-Kasongo, the nephew of 
Conrad's novel as he used
it as the basis for 
Apocalypse Now.
 We used this film  as a transition to the unit on Vietnam.
